plans.brokenNote: This plan is broken: at least {{n}} installments are overdue. Nothing changes automatically; follow up with the debtor or cancel the plan.
plans.cancelHint: The allocations stay as evidence of what was paid; paid installments stay paid and the others become cancelled. The debt does not change. This cannot be undone.
plans.deallocateHint: The payment stays approved and the debt does not change; only this link to the installment is voided. Amount:

sessions.title: Sessions and access
sessions.signOutHint: Ends every session of this user on the server. The account stays active.

sessions.reasonOptional: Optional. It is kept in the audit log with your name.
sessions.signOutResult: All sessions ended. Sessions started before this time are refused (Riyadh):
sessions.deactivateHint: Deactivating blocks sign-in and also ends the user's sessions.
sessions.activateHint: Activating allows sign-in again. Old sessions stay ended.
sessions.deactivateBody: The user can no longer sign in, and every existing session ends at once. Activating the account later does not revive those sessions; the user signs in again.
sessions.activateBody: The user can sign in again. Sessions that ended when the account was deactivated stay ended.
sessions.deactivatedToast: Account deactivated; its sessions were ended.
sessions.validAfter: Sessions started before this time are refused (Riyadh):
sessions.selfHint: You cannot deactivate your own account.
sessions.noActions: You have no session or account actions for this user.
sessions.hiddenFieldTitle: You don't have the permission to see this field.

targets.subtitleContract: Monthly targets of this contract. Every change is kept as a new revision.
targets.legacyCurrent: Target fields in the form above

targets.monthsNote: A target stays in force in the following months until a new one is set. Past months are locked.
targets.historyEmptyHint: The history starts with the first save or the imported baseline.

targets.percentHint: More than 0 and at most 100, at most 4 decimals. Applied to the original debt of the unarchived cases.

targets.noneHintContract: The contract has no target for this month.

team.subtitle: Target vs actual per collector for one month ({{tz}}):
team.subtitleLoading: Target vs actual per collector for one month.
team.ownNote: This view shows only your own figures. Team-wide figures need the admin dashboard permission.

wrapup.uncertain: This call is uncertain. It can be wrapped up once it is reconciled or a supervisor resolves it.
wrapup.notYet: The call has not ended yet.

admin.title: Calling administration
admin.subtitle: Extensions, calling hours, do-not-call blocks and the calling service.
admin.noSession: The calling service has not reported a PBX session.
admin.connectedNote: “Connected” is the calling service's AMI session at its last report, not a guarantee that a call will go through.
admin.currentOwner: It has an owner now: tick “replace” to move it.
admin.legacyValue: The user's legacy extension field holds {{value}}.
admin.replace: Replace an existing owner or the user's current extension
admin.replaceHint: Never while the extension has an active call.
admin.legacyConflicts: {{count}} other user(s) still hold this value in the legacy field; they were not changed.
admin.releaseHint: {{name}} will no longer own it. Refused while the extension has an active call.
admin.noExtensionsHint: Assign one, or adopt a legacy value after review.
admin.extNote: Ownership decides who may call and who gets softphone credentials. The legacy extension field is only a mirror for the old screens and CDR attribution.
admin.driftIntro: Legacy extension values are never imported silently. Review each difference; “adopt” turns one value into ownership with a reason.
admin.adoptHint: {{name}} becomes the owner of {{ext}}. Other users holding the same legacy value are reported, not changed.
admin.windowsRule: Start is inclusive and end exclusive; an end before the start runs overnight and belongs to its start day; 24:00 is allowed as an end. The hours restrict new calls only; they never end a call in progress.
admin.noPolicy: No policy yet: calling is closed until hours are saved.
admin.closedAllWeek: No hours: calling is closed all week.
admin.windowsNote: The PBX dialplan checks its own copy of the hours; holidays are checked by the application only.
admin.blocksIntro: Cases marked do-not-call by a wrap-up in your scope. Lifting a block needs a reason and is recorded. (The API has no list of all blocks; this list comes from the do-not-call wrap-ups.)
admin.noBlocks: No do-not-call blocks in your scope.

block.liftHint: Calling this case becomes possible again. Record why (for example, the debtor asked to be called again).

err.already_dispatching: The call was already handed to the PBX; it can no longer be cancelled. Hang up on your phone.
err.call_not_found: Call not found (or not in your scope).
err.conversation_not_evidenced: The PBX shows no bridged conversation for this call. Choose no answer, busy or do not call.
err.wrapup_exists: This call already has a wrap-up.
err.wrapup_not_allowed: A wrap-up is possible once the call ended or failed (an uncertain call needs reconciliation first).
err.promise_discussed_is_not_a_promise: “Promise discussed” never creates a promise. Use “Connected” with an agreed promise.
err.promise_not_agreed: A promise needs the debtor's explicit agreement.
err.promise_not_allowed: A promise can only be recorded with the outcome “Connected”.
err.contact_required: A wrong number needs the contact that was called.
err.not_uncertain: The call is no longer uncertain.
err.call_still_live: The PBX still showed channels of this call at the last check. Wait for it to end.
err.flag_already_resolved: The review flag is already resolved.
err.already_assigned: The user already owns this extension.
err.extension_owned: The extension has an owner. Release it first or tick “replace”.
err.user_has_extension: The user already has an extension. Tick “replace” to move them.
err.extension_in_use: The extension has an active call; it cannot be changed now.
err.legacy_extension_invalid: The user's legacy extension is not 2–6 digits.
err.legacy_extension_changed: The legacy extension changed; reload the list.
err.no_members: Add at least one active member before starting.
err.campaign_stopped: A stopped campaign cannot be changed.
err.member_inactive: You were removed from this campaign's roster.
err.ready_in_other_campaign: You are ready in another campaign; go offline there first.
err.call_in_progress: Finish the current call and its wrap-up first.
err.member_not_allowed: A member must be an active user of your team.
err.idempotency_request_in_progress: The same request is still being processed; try again in a moment.
err.not_found: Not found, or not in your scope.
err.route_missing: This part of the API is not available on the running server yet (it needs a restart after the update).

problem.not_allowed_for_outcome: is not allowed with this outcome

cdr.reasonHint: Why these PBX records are imported (kept with every record).
cdr.sourceNameHint: Duplicates are detected within one source. Default: issabel.
cdr.timezoneHint: For dates without an offset. Default: Asia/Riyadh.
cdr.windowHint: 0–3600, default 300: a number matches a call attempt within this window.
cdr.rules: Records attribute to a case in your scope by the CRM tag, the number and time, or the number alone. Unmatched and ambiguous records are never imported; they stay in the preview and the error file. A blank duration stays unknown. Imported records are evidence next to the calls; they never change them.
